indicator.subject: Mathematics
indicator.content_standard: B5.3.4.1 Describe the position of objects in space using the cardinal points
indicator.objective: Tell the position and motion of objects in space using the cardinal points north, south, east and west

skills.description: Use N, S, E, W to describe position.
Describe motion on a grid using cardinal points.
Give directions from one location to another.

spec.difficultyPlan: 20 questions: 5 at difficulty 1, 7 at difficulty 2, 5 at difficulty 3, 3 at difficulty 4.
misconceptions: Describing motion without a reference point.

questions.stem: Which direction is opposite to North?
If you face East, what is to your right?
questions.explanation: South is to the right when facing East.

questions.stem: If you face North, what direction is behind you?
A point moves from (1, 2) to (1, 5). In which direction did it move?
questions.explanation: Moving up on a grid is North.
questions.misconception: Saying East because the y-axis is vertical.

questions.stem: A point moves from (4, 3) to (2, 3). In which direction did it move?
questions.explanation: Moving left on a grid is West.

questions.stem: The school is East of Kofi's house. The hospital is North of Kofi's house. What is the position of the school relative to the hospital?
hints: From hospital to school is right and down.
questions.explanation: The school is South-East of the hospital.

questions.stem: Start at (2, 1). Move 3 squares North. What is the new y-coordinate?
Start at (5, 4). Move 2 squares West. What is the new x-coordinate?
Describe the position of the door relative to the teacher's desk using cardinal points.
questions.explanation: Example: The door is East of the teacher's desk.

questions.stem: Give directions from (0, 0) to (3, 2) using North, South, East, West.
questions.explanation: Move 3 squares East, then 2 squares North.

questions.stem: Start at (3, 3). Move 4 squares South. What is the new y-coordinate?
On a map, if North is up, where is West?
Point P is North of Q. Point R is East of Q. What is the direction of R from P?
hints: Draw Q at (0,0), P at (0,1), R at (1,0).
From P to R is right and down.

questions.stem: Explain how to move from (2, 2) to (6, 5) using cardinal directions.
questions.explanation: Move 4 squares East, then 3 squares North.

questions.stem: Start at (1, 1). Move 3 North, then 4 East. What is the final x-coordinate?
A pupil walks from (1, 1) to (1, 5) and then to (4, 5). Describe the path.
questions.explanation: Move 4 squares North, then 3 squares East.

questions.stem: If you face South, what is on your left?
Start at (3, 2). Move 2 squares West, then 3 squares South. What is the final position? (Enter as x,y)
A treasure is buried at (5, 7). You are at (2, 2). Give the directions to reach the treasure using only North, South, East, West.
questions.explanation: Move 3 squares East, then 5 squares North.
